subject.ruleQuote: KXFDAAPPROVE-GED-26AUG01: "If the FDA approves gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer for marketing before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes." (Finalized yes; archived for the record.)
